$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box on the pages measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number needs a real source: a box that was measured (how is said in `from`; Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, on a clean install of this theme) or a field's schema maxLength (none of these fields declares one). A text no page draws in a box has no number: it is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the business name is printed as visible words only in the footer copyright line (Footer.astro, `{name}` of `copyright`); filled with a longer name until the line gains a row: 123 characters at 1440 px, 45 at 768 px (one row), 41 at 390 px (two rows)

the placeholder is drawn inside the e-mail field of the newsletter band on one line: the field is 173 px wide inside its padding at 390 px (Work Sans 15 px, 22 characters of running text) and 431 px at 768 and 1440 px (54 characters)

the site title is used only in the document `<title>` and `og:site_name` (Base.astro), and as the logo's alt text when neither the logo nor the business name has one (brand.ts): no page draws it in a box and the setting declares no maxLength, so it has no limit (the business name the footer prints is its own slot, chrome.brand_name, which is measured)
the label is the accessible name (`aria-label`) of the menu icon button in the header (Header.astro): no page draws it in a box, and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit
the label is the accessible name (`aria-label`) of the light/dark icon button in the header (Header.astro): no page draws it in a box, and the field declares no maxLength, so it has no limit
